notes.title: Playtest #3!
notes.content:
🎮 Welcome to Playtest #3!


We've been working hard to improve Kingdom Loop, and we can’t wait to hear what you think!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45524139/0ab563088c44586fd427e97349d37e6256a42b7f.png"]

This update brings a ton of new features:

🃏 Cards are now even more valuable —
Winning battles grants you random cards — the stronger the enemy, the better the reward.

⚔️ New Units —
A variety of new combat units have been added to the Human faction.

🏡 Tile Upgrades Through Combos! —
Upgraded tiles can now evolve for free when placed in the right combinations!

🕹 Turn-Based Combat System —
Battles are now fully turn-based, with deeper tactical mechanics.

📖 Story and Dialogue Updates

🏆 Special Grail Tile —
Can be found at the center of the map.

💬 Share your feedback!
Your impressions help us make the game even better. And remember — this is just the beginning. There’s much more to come!
